# Browser test photography

These images are independent of the Frontgate and Grandin Road reference sites.
They are sample furniture/interior photography from Unsplash, not photographs of
the test product fixtures. They are not served by the application or included in
the storefront build. Playwright serves selected files through intercepted
test-only requests. Source: https://unsplash.com/license

All downloads use `https://images.unsplash.com/{photo-id}?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=85`
(1920px for hero images retained from the initial visual phase).
